title: Verification status

license.pending_subtitle: We received the license. Review takes up to 24 hours. You can browse and chat now.
license.verified_subtitle: The verified badge now appears on your business profile. You can submit offers.

deed.pending_subtitle: We received the property deed. Review takes up to 24 hours. You can browse and chat now.
deed.verified_subtitle: Property deed verified successfully. You can proceed and publish your project.
